about: Based on Boxshelf by sassiestrhihno (https://github.com/sassiestrhihno/boxshelf-source, GPL-3.0). Written by Haseo (https://github.com/Haseosama) in their Boxshelf fork and by Zak (https://github.com/ZakAuMiel) in theirs, ZakAuMiel/boxshelf-source: the interface's English texts and their French. {n} is the English text's n-th varying part; {n?x} is x when that part isn't empty.
